question:
Which of the following pair of cricket tournament run by BCCI and its type is correct?

I. Vijay Hazare Trophy - List A matches

II. Syed Mushtaq Ali Trophy - T20 matches
solution:
The correct answer is __**Both I and II**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The Vijay Hazare Trophy is a domestic cricket competition in India, organized by the BCCI, featuring List A matches.
 
• The **Syed Mushtaq Ali Trophy** is another domestic cricket tournament organized by the BCCI, focusing on T20 matches.
 
• Both tournaments are part of India's domestic cricket structure and serve as platforms for selecting players for international matches.
 
• While the Vijay Hazare Trophy is played in a 50-over format, the Syed Mushtaq Ali Trophy is a shorter format with **20 **overs per side.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Vijay Hazare Trophy:** Named after legendary cricketer Vijay Hazare, this tournament is a 50-over competition often considered the domestic equivalent of One Day Internationals (ODIs).
 
• **Syed Mushtaq Ali Trophy:** Named after the Indian cricketer Syed Mushtaq Ali, this tournament is focused on T20 cricket and has contributed significantly to the development of India's T20 talent pool.
 
• BCCI (Board of Control for Cricket in India) organizes these tournaments to provide a structured pathway for players to showcase their skills at a professional level.
 
• Performances in these tournaments often influence selection for **IPL teams** and the **Indian national cricket team**.
